claims.text: The corrected canonical run scored 32 test donors.
Intervals use 1,000 donor-bootstrap replicates.
Arm A has 19,018 scorable natural-stratum test cells.
Arm A logistic regression (M4) closed-set macro-F1 was 0.694 (M4 outputs adopted unchanged from run 29879296).
Lower bound of the paired M3 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M3 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
Lower bound of the paired M6 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M6 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
At OP-cov, Arm A M4 accepted 0.817 of scorable test cells.
At OP-cov, Arm A M4 accepted error was 0.087.
Arm B M4 accepted 0.659 of removed-type (ASC, MAIT, pDC) cells with a known label at OP-cov.
Arm B M3 accepted 0.892 of removed-type cells with a known label at OP-cov.
Arm A M4 natural-unknown false acceptance (20 erythroid cells) was 0.15.

The lower bound of the bootstrap interval for M15 was 0.105, below the 0.15 point estimate; the interval [0.105, 1.000] contains the point estimate, is very wide, and rests on the 874 of 1,000 replicates that contained an unknown cell.
Protein check, 10k file: M4 agreement_accepted was 0.904.
Protein check, 10k file: the denominator of M4 agreement_accepted was 6,009 accepted, protein-resolved cells.
Protein check, 10k file: M4 agreement on gateable predictions was 0.978.
Both replacement CITE-seq files were eligible for the protein check.
Lower bound of the paired M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
Arm A M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) closed-set macro-F1 was 0.689.
At OP-cov, Arm A M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) accepted 0.798 of scorable test cells, the lowest Arm A coverage at OP-cov.
At OP-cov, Arm A M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) accepted error was 0.089.
Arm A M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) natural-unknown false acceptance at OP-cov was 0.20, i.e. 4 of the 20 erythroid cells.
Arm B M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) accepted 0.833 of removed-type cells with a known label at OP-cov.
Arm B M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) known-versus-removed AUROC was 0.441, the lowest of the Arm B matched methods and below 0.5.
Arm A M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) OP-err threshold was 0.9999998, at the probability ceiling.
The HIHA authors report that their expert annotation was guided by CellTypist Immune_All models and Seurat label transfer.
Models trained on the scTab corpus showed lower macro-F1 on studies added in a later Census release.
Rejection options can fail when a whole population is missing from the reference.
scTab used donor holdout as a compromise between random and study-level splits.
Thresholds tuned for 90% validation coverage did not flag most cells of removed near-neighbour types as unfamiliar.
claims.limitations: Three near-neighbour immune classes, mostly rare top-up cells; says nothing about distant or genuinely novel types.

claims.text: The natural-unknown false-acceptance intervals (20 erythroid cells) are uninformative; for the 20 erythroid natural unknowns only counts are reported.
claims.limitations: 126 of 1,000 replicates contained no unknown cell and are undefined for this metric, so its interval rests on 874 replicates and is conditional on an unknown cell being present. No interval of this kind in the corrected run excluded its point estimate. Undefined replicates arose only from this metric and from OP-err not being attainable (1,000 for M3 and M6). A replicate missing a macro-F1 class scores that class 0 and is kept, which biases replicate macro-F1 downward with unrecorded frequency; macro-F1 intervals are not conditional on the class being present.

claims.text: The two protein agreement measures have different denominators; the gateable-prediction denominator is a smaller method-specific subset that is not recorded, so neither measure is an accuracy and no method ranking is drawn.
claims.limitations: Replacement author-filtered inputs, unknown donor identity, zero-filled genes, fine-versus-coarse label mismatch; descriptive only.

claims.text: No closed-set macro-F1 difference between M4 and M3, M5 (seed 0, corrected v2) or M6 was resolved at the precision of these intervals; this is not evidence of equivalence.
claims.limitations: Within-study donor-bootstrap intervals over four fixed test studies, conditional on fixed validation thresholds and training seed 0 for every seeded method; no equivalence margin was pre-specified; training-seed variance was not estimated.

full_inventory: evidence/paper-claim-inventory.json is the original 58-claim inventory of manuscript literals for run 29879296 (sha256 314aee11ac86b01fe92b896fa0af716e14eeaed4a1c13f09fc4ca76828c7b69e). It is preserved unchanged, predates result version m5-seed0-v2 and is historical only; its M5 literals are superseded. This ledger is authoritative for current claims.
